objective: Implement positive conservative interval cell-integral remap with bounded memory and a usable remap perturbation diagnostic.
scope: Same-domain one-dimensional measure-coordinate grids, nonnegative scalar integrals, fixed capacity; no ODE accepted-step hook yet.

implementation.allocation_scope: Two Vec allocations at workspace construction; remap paths have no allocation/resize calls.
implementation.refusal_atomicity: Caller destination untouched until all numerical checks complete.
implementation.mass_tolerance: Explicit finite nonnegative caller threshold on floating diagnostic relative mass discrepancy.

claims.statement: Overlap matrix is positive column stochastic; conserves scalar integral and contracts weighted L1 differences in exact real arithmetic.
Overlapping sorted partitions require at most n+m-1 positive overlap segments.
Remap perturbations enter e_next <= L*e + temporal_spatial_defect + remap_defect + arithmetic_error.
Eight standalone Rust tests pass for exact hand-computed maps, positivity, conservation, contractions, changing dimensions and atomic refusal.
Remap report values are floating diagnostics, not outward-rounded certificate values.

validation.cargo_integration_test: not_run_by_this_unit; root integration validation may supersede

independent_review.result: no blocking issue found in code/proofs; units clarification applied
independent_review.change: Changed photon dN/dU to per-proper-volume dn/du_gamma and documented required proper volume factor.

scientific_contract.measure: Edges are cumulative positive measure, not necessarily raw energy or theta.
scientific_contract.photon_number_energy_coordinate: E^3/3 for measure E^2 dE; normalization and angle measure handled consistently by caller.
scientific_contract.simultaneous_number_energy: Not implemented; requires separate constrained multi-moment reconstruction.
scientific_contract.angular_scope: General Bianchi needs S^2; theta-only requires axisymmetry.
scientific_contract.polarization: Signed Stokes components unsupported by this nonnegative scalar API.
scientific_contract.temporal_order: Fifth-order time integration does not remove remap error; per-remap O(h^6) is sufficient when O(1/h) remaps occur under stability assumptions.

next_actions.action: Bind the actual photon variable, phase-space measure, normalization and physical norm in BASS/rei.
Add accepted-step transactional state/grid/epoch commit, cache invalidation, mapped dense-output identity and controller norm update.
Validate fixed threshold-aligned energy mesh, number/energy accounting, independent spatial/time refinement.
Implement positivity-realizable multi-moment reconstruction and directed remap error upper bounds.
